description: Use when working on Jira tickets.

items.installHint: Register Atlassian's official remote MCP (https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp) under the server name `atlassian` in `~/.claude.json`, `~/.codex/config.toml`, or `~/.gemini/settings.json` — or point the same name at any self-hosted Jira MCP package.
items.title: Atlassian MCP (Jira/Confluence)

items.installHint: Install Atlassian's official CLI (`brew tap atlassian/homebrew-acli && brew install acli`, or download from https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/acli/) and run `acli auth login` so issue reads, fallback transitions, and verification commands work when MCP is unavailable.
items.title: Atlassian CLI (acli)

name: Working With Jira
